rows.text: You are in Hall No. 5 of the Sigma Galaxy United Theater. You find it hard to believe that you're sitting among a group of well-dressed and sophisticated ladies and gentlemen.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You feel a buzz of anticipation for the show behind the red velvet curtains. You start picturing the Salsotto Troupe's cosmic princess, whose dress has a hem wide enough to cover the entire stage.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Or it might be a scientific installation performance, the favorite of the old folks from the Jacobin School of Mathematics and Science. The Pronto Expert System, an AI device, is used to calculate the plot of the play.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Or, to be more mighty, the Sigma Maiden's unplugged accompaniment. That eternal "Maiden" is a man whose figure contains the Golden Ratio. His coiled posture when lifting the Sun is forever etched in the memory of the entire world.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Soon, the curtains are drawn. On the stage stands a lady with slimy blue skin. She lifts her hand and starts to sing with a synthesized coloratura.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You puff your chest out and try to move your tense muscles, but you find yourself unable to move — You feel something cold pressed against the side of your waist. Yes... you're very sure... that it is a gun.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "We've changed the program. The era of Akivili has ended, and classical arts are dead. Nowadays, action movies are the crowd-pleasers. Tell me your choice." A man's voice says.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Um, that's not what I meant." The man sounds bewildered. He licks his lips and continues. "I wanted to ask whether you prefer musicals or action movies."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Watch the secret flick.
Musical.
Obtain a 2-star Blessing of Elation.

A potion is injected into your lumbar spine, and a joy of universal harmony and unity shoots through your cerebral fluid. As the Silvia Spirits encircle you and start singing a hymn, you sway your body along with the music.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Action.
Obtain a 2-star Blessing of The Hunt.

A potion is injected into your lumbar spine, and steel weapons and blazing bullets jet through your cerebral fluid. The art of explosion is spectacular. You breathe in the chemical exhaust gas, feeling refreshed.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Please let me live.
"You've... got the wrong idea." There is urgency in his voice. "You're watching an interactive play. This is a part of the show."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A potion is injected into your lumbar spine, and a joy of universal harmony and unity shoots through your cerebral fluid. Countless steel weapons and blazing bullets flying through your psyche.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "This is an interactive play. This is a part of the show. We hope to perceive the modernity of art through it — to break the fourth wall. I don't have a lot of experience with this job yet. I'm very sorry."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "We're sorry for providing an overly realistic experience for you. The interactive part has now ended. Please continue enjoying the show."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
